'''Beladi Vosi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She accrued a lot of debt since childhood, and learned to be ruthless. She preferred to depart with her stolen goods rather than engage in violence, and was excessively charming. Her business partners found her to be a source of many jobs, and as long as they expected betrayal from the smuggler, could even earn credits from working with her.<ref name="Fly Casual" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beladi Vos appears as the Friendly Foe template in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
